newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds-Prices mostly steady to higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds-Prices mostly steady to higher.

text.p: U.S. spot millfeed prices were mostly steady to higher on Tuesday as dealers wait and see how much run time flour mills will be taking during the Thanksgiving holiday week.
"Everybody is waiting to see if the flour mill times will back off somewhat or significantly, that is up in the air," a St Louis dealer said. "Feed business is assuredly better."
But he noted regardless of what the flour mills do, the feed mills are running stronger. "That is a fact," he said.
There is a lot of demand for fill-in type loads, he added.
In the northeast, the flour mills are expected to take more time than the feed mills, a Buffalo dealer said.
The feed mills will be down on Thanksgiving but they will all be back and running on Friday. Some of the flour mills may well take a four-day weekend starting next Thursday.

But he said demand was fairly flat. "Local corn is displacing some of the midds in formulas because it is certainly a lot more readily available and it is cheaper than it was a month or so ago," the Buffalo dealer said.
In Texas, a dealer said prices would move higher because flour runs will be shorter.
